answer: Think of Granted air quality officer licence with environmental health attestation as a toll booth: a licence health officers renew after monitoring audits, so the cipher of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The terrace is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The relic is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
